Ready to merge from my side: no new problems, and the double charge I flagged last time is fixed. Next: a human approval on the PR. Nothing was merged or deployed.

What changed

When a payment provider was slow, the retry worker could charge an invoice a second time. Now every charge takes the invoice's key first, and the retry checks it:

  1. The charge says "I'm charging invoice X" before it calls the provider.
  2. A retry sees the pending charge and waits.
  3. A late webhook for a settled charge is dropped.

The risky part

Every charge path has to go through the same key check, so a new payment method must use it too.
